checks.detail: Attaching media to a person does not promote a claim, relationship, identity bridge, or evidence state.

checks.detail: Living-person media must be public only when explicitly marked public; media visibility never overrides living-person field redaction.

checks.label: Media attachments cannot promote genealogy evidence
checks.detail: Uploading or linking a photo/document never changes a person, relationship, claim, or evidence state.

checks.label: Living-person media is server-forced private
checks.detail: Media linked to a living person is forced private by the server. Public visibility is allowed only for non-living people and only by explicit editor choice.

checks.label: Media removal is soft-delete only
checks.detail: Media deletion is a soft-delete tombstone; binary content is retained for controlled recovery/audit until separately purged.

checks.label: Revision diff is review-only and cannot auto-approve
checks.detail: Pending shared revisions are compared with the preceding approved family-edit snapshot for reviewer clarity. The diff never approves, merges, or promotes anything automatically. Approve and Reject remain explicit actions separate from the diff display.

checks.label: Family collaboration is account-attributed and non-canonical
checks.detail: Authentication, roles, attribution, storage, and review workflow never promote or rewrite canonical v10 evidence.

checks.label: Revision submission and review are role-gated
checks.detail: Approve/reject requires Editor or Admin role and remains an explicit review action. Revision objects carry a version field and review requests include the expected version so stale review attempts fail instead of silently overwriting a newer state.

checks.label: Shared editor key is reduced to bootstrap or migration
checks.detail: The existing FAMILY_EDITOR_WRITE_KEY may be used only to bootstrap the first administrator or as a temporary legacy migration credential. It is not the normal collaboration identity.

checks.label: Production build exposes non-genealogical deployment provenance
checks.detail: Production can be compared directly with repository HEAD using build-info.json; deployment provenance does not alter genealogy data.

checks.label: Shared collaboration no longer requires Netlify Database
checks.detail: Netlify Blobs · Each revision is an independent append-only Blob object with an incrementing version. Review requests carry expectedVersion and stale reviews are rejected.

checks.label: Family-first presentation cannot rewrite canonical evidence
checks.detail: v12.6 changes presentation and navigation only. Canonical v10 evidence, claims, relationships, source states, identity bridge status, and promotion gates remain immutable.

checks.label: Research mode remains available without dominating family browsing
checks.detail: Family mode prioritizes Home, Tree, People, and Family Groups. Research and archive navigation remain available but visually secondary.

checks.label: Plain-language evidence labels are presentation-only
checks.detail: Family mode may translate controlled evidence tokens into plain-language labels for presentation only; stored evidence states are never rewritten.

checks.label: Mobile family browsing retains the visual tree
checks.detail: The visual focal-person tree remains the dominant family exploration surface. Full-tree expert mode remains available and mobile retains the visual tree instead of replacing it with a list-only experience.
